# freshdesk_contact (Resource)

A contact who raises tickets.

~> Deleting this resource soft-deletes the contact. Freshdesk keeps it recoverable for 30 days before removing it permanently.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "freshdesk_contact" "avery" {
  name             = "Avery Stone"
  email            = "avery@northwind.example"
  job_title        = "Operations Lead"
  company_id       = freshdesk_company.northwind.id
  view_all_tickets = true
  tags             = ["priority-customer"]
}

resource "freshdesk_company" "northwind" {
  name = "Northwind Traders"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the contact.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Postal address of the contact.
- `company_id` (Number) ID of the company the contact belongs to.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values keyed by field name. Non-string values are given as JSON.
- `description` (String) Free-text note about the contact.
- `email` (String) Primary email address. At least one of `email`, `phone`, `mobile`, `twitter_id` or `unique_external_id` must be set.

-> Freshdesk stores addresses folded to lower case. This attribute compares case-insensitively, so writing capitals does not produce a perpetual diff.
- `job_title` (String) Job title of the contact.
- `language` (String) Language code of the contact, for example `en`.
- `mobile` (String) Mobile number of the contact.
- `other_emails` (Set of String) Additional email addresses for the contact.
- `phone` (String) Telephone number of the contact.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the contact.
- `time_zone` (String) Time zone of the contact. Defaults to the helpdesk's.
- `twitter_id` (String) Twitter handle of the contact.
- `unique_external_id` (String) Identifier of the contact in an external system.
- `view_all_tickets` (Boolean) Whether the contact can see every ticket raised by their company, rather than only their own.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the contact has activated their portal account.
- `contact_type` (String) Contact type reported by the API.
- `created_at` (String) When the contact was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the contact.
- `updated_at` (String) When the contact was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_contact.example 42
```
